analyzed_vuln.description: COLR v1 closure traversal dispatches into Paint data without validating/sanitizing the referenced BaseGlyphV1Record paint offset/contents first. In COLR::closure_forV1(), `const Paint &paint = &baseglyphV1_records + baseglyphV1record.paint; paint.dispatch(&c);` can produce an out-of-bounds Paint pointer from malformed font data; then Paint::dispatch reads `u.format` (1-byte BEInt) from invalid memory, causing the UBSan SEGV seen at hb-algs.hh:94.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The subset path (_populate_gids_to_retain in harfbuzz/src/hb-subset-plan.cc) always calls `colr.closure_forV1(...)` when a COLR table exists. A crafted font with COLR version=1 and malformed BaseGlyphV1List/BaseGlyphV1Record paint offsets (or otherwise invalid v1 paint graph) can make closure_forV1 compute an invalid Paint address. During dispatch, reading `u.format` triggers an invalid read. The provided PoC (minimal font with COLR/maxp) reaches this path via hb_subset_plan_create -> _populate_gids_to_retain -> COLR::closure_forV1.
